title: Electrical Power — Aft Secondary Distribution Box — Higher Rated Terminations Alone

issue.reason: Initial issue of the terminations-only bulletin for the six aircraft with an existing rack ventilation duct.

abstract: A short bulletin for the six aircraft that already carry an equipment rack ventilation duct from an earlier cabin conversion, covering the terminations and the relay without repeating the duct installation.

sections.planning_reason: Six aircraft were converted to a high-density cabin layout early in their life and received an equipment rack ventilation duct at that time, in the same position the ventilated distribution box standard uses. On those aircraft the main bulletin would have the engineer cut an opening that already exists and run a duct that is already there, which invites a mistake. This bulletin covers only the work those aircraft actually need.
sections.description: The harness is re-terminated with higher rated lugs, the feeder relay is replaced by an item qualified to the higher continuous rating, and the internal baffle is installed against the existing duct inlet.
sections.accomplishment_summary: De-energise the aircraft and apply the electrical safety precautions. Open the aft equipment rack access in zone 244 and confirm that the ventilation duct is present and that its inlet aligns with the box lower face. Do not continue if the duct is absent; use the main bulletin instead. Remove the secondary distribution box cover. Install the internal baffle and set the standoff with spacers AES140047-2A. Re-terminate the harness D2450122851975 with the higher rated lugs and refit the connector HAR83831-56. Replace the feeder relay CIDE636017-51. Re-strap the feeder contactor 89PC to the restored group allocation. Do the ventilation flow measurement at the box inlet and the cabin outlet functional check. Remove the cabin placard, install the cover and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable only to the six listed aircraft, which carry an equipment rack ventilation duct from an earlier cabin conversion and are at the interim derating standard. Any other aircraft must use the main bulletin, which includes the duct installation.
sections.material_note: Kit K2450-1036-01 contains the baffle, the relay and the lug set. No cutting template is issued because no opening is cut. The removed relay is returned to Aeralis for credit.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled A-check, or within 36 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.

title: Electrical Power — Aft Secondary Distribution Box — Higher Rated Terminations Alone

issue.reason: Embodiment held and the effectivity re-stated, because the same aft feeder margin is committed by a cabin change still in pre-analysis.

abstract: A short bulletin for the six aircraft that already carry an equipment rack ventilation duct from an earlier cabin conversion, covering the terminations and the relay, and currently held while the aft feeder margin is reallocated.

sections.planning_reason: Six aircraft were converted to a high-density cabin layout early in their life and received an equipment rack ventilation duct at that time, in the same position the ventilated distribution box standard uses. On those aircraft the main bulletin would have the engineer cut an opening that already exists and run a duct that is already there, which invites a mistake. This bulletin covers only the work those aircraft actually need.
sections.description: The harness is re-terminated with higher rated lugs, the feeder relay is replaced by an item qualified to the higher continuous rating, and the internal baffle is installed against the existing duct inlet.
sections.accomplishment_summary: De-energise the aircraft and apply the electrical safety precautions. Open the aft equipment rack access in zone 244 and confirm that the ventilation duct is present and that its inlet aligns with the box lower face. Do not continue if the duct is absent; use the main bulletin instead. Remove the secondary distribution box cover. Install the internal baffle and set the standoff with spacers AES140047-2A. Re-terminate the harness D2450122851975 with the higher rated lugs and refit the connector HAR83831-56. Replace the feeder relay CIDE636017-51. Re-strap the feeder contactor 89PC to the restored group allocation. Do the ventilation flow measurement at the box inlet and the cabin outlet functional check. Remove the cabin placard, install the cover and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable only to the six listed aircraft, which carry an equipment rack ventilation duct from an earlier cabin conversion and are at the interim derating standard. Any other aircraft must use the main bulletin, which includes the duct installation. Embodiment is held with effect from the date of this revision. The higher rated terminations restore part of the aft feeder margin, and a cabin change in pre-analysis proposes to allocate the same margin to seat power; if both proceed against the same figure the margin is committed twice and the first aircraft to take both trips the aft group on ground supply during boarding. The hold is lifted and the effectivity re-stated once the seat power allocation is fixed against the feeder run rating. Aircraft already embodied are unaffected and need no action.
sections.material_note: Kit K2450-1036-01 contains the baffle, the relay and the lug set. No cutting template is issued because no opening is cut. Kit supply is suspended for the duration of the hold; operators holding an unopened kit keep it, because the hold is expected to be lifted rather than the bulletin cancelled. The removed relay is returned to Aeralis for credit.

type_data.compliance_time: Held. No new embodiment is to be planned until the effectivity is re-stated. Aircraft already embodied need no action.

revision_history.reason: Embodiment held pending the aft feeder margin reallocation; effectivity information restated and kit supply suspended
